step1_analysis.circuit_type: Passive Bias and AC Coupling Network
step1_analysis.description: A passive network extracted from a power amplifier or predistorter circuit, consisting of a DC bias tee with AC coupling for the input, and an AC coupling capacitor for the output. The active device (transistor) is missing from the extraction, leaving only the passive matching/biasing components.

paper_reference.title: A Highly Efficient Linearized Wide-Band CDMA Handset Power Amplifier Based on Predistortion Under Various Bias Conditions

DC_Bias_Voltage.description: DC voltage established at the active device input node (n0)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Assuming equal bias resistors (10k) and a 1.8V supply for SKY130.

Midband_Insertion_Loss.description: AC attenuation of the input coupling network in the passband

sky130_expected.calculation: Ideal capacitor coupling with high impedance load gives ~0 dB loss.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Passive AC coupling should have minimal loss in the passband.

High_Pass_Cutoff.description: Lower 3dB cutoff frequency of the input AC coupling

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on chosen component values for the testbench (10nF and 10k resistors).

Power_Amplifier_Gain.description: Overall gain of the power amplifier (requires active device)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Cannot be measured on this passive sub-circuit as the transistor is missing from the netlist.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC bias and AC frequency response of the passive coupling networks. Component values are added to the netlist to allow simulation.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Passive Bias and Coupling Network Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* DUT (Values added for simulation)
R1 n0 label_net_0 10k
C1 n0 0 1p
C2 n0 label_net_1 10n
C3 n1 label_net_2 10n
R2 n1 0 10k
R3 n0 0 10k

* Sources
Vbias label_net_0 0 1.8
Vin label_net_1 0 dc 0 ac 1
Vtest n1 0 dc 0 ac 1
Rload label_net_2 0 50

.control
* DC Operating Point
op
print v(n0)
let v_bias_n0 = v(n0)

* AC Analysis
ac dec 20 1k 1G
let gain_in_db = vdb(n0)
let gain_out_db = vdb(label_net_2)

* Input Network Metrics
meas ac midband_gain_in find gain_in_db at=1MEG
let target_hp_in = midband_gain_in - 3
meas ac f3db_hp_in when gain_in_db=target_hp_in rise=1
let target_lp_in = midband_gain_in - 3
meas ac f3db_lp_in when gain_in_db=target_lp_in fall=1

* Output Network Metrics
meas ac midband_gain_out find gain_out_db at=10MEG
let target_hp_out = midband_gain_out - 3
meas ac f3db_hp_out when gain_out_db=target_hp_out rise=1

quit
.endc
.end
